definitions.explanation: Creations of the mind such as inventions, literary and artistic works, designs, symbols, and names used in commerce. A legal and business term covering patents, copyrights, trademarks, and trade secrets.

examples.japanese: {知的財産|ちてきざいさん}を{守|まも}る。
{知的財産権|ちてきざいさんけん}の{侵害|しんがい}は{違法|いほう}です。
examples.english: Infringement of intellectual property rights is illegal.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{知的財産|ちてきざいさん}の{管理|かんり}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れている。
examples.english: This company puts effort into managing its intellectual property.

notes: Often abbreviated as {知財|ちざい}. Common compounds: {知的財産権|ちてきざいさんけん} (intellectual property rights), {知的財産|ちてきざいさん}{戦略|せんりゃく} (IP strategy). Related terms: {特許|とっきょ} (patent), {著作権|ちょさくけん} (copyright), {商標|しょうひょう} (trademark). The abbreviation {知財|ちざい} is very common in business contexts: {知財|ちざい}{部|ぶ} (IP department).
